text: . Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives like Jan Bhagidari.Jan Bhagidari, which means public participation, is a core governance model under Narendra Modi government. Schemes that utilize the Jan Bhagidari model include Swachh Bharat  Mission, Catch the Rain, Vocal for Local, and Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan. Citizens in India had traditionally been treated as passive beneficiaries of government schemes. Jan Bhagidari has brought a change to this and fostered local ownership and behavioural change in people. Prime Minister Narendra Modi regularly highlights Jan Bhagidari as a core pillar of nation-building through his monthly radio program, Mann Ki Baat. In Mann Ki Baat  last month, Prime Minister Modi again highlighted Jan Bhagidari as a driving force for social change, urging citizens to join collective movements like the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan.Talking to Akashvani News, Shivendra Singh, a resident of Prayagraj, spoke about how he and his family and friends believe in Jan Bhagidari and go Vocal For Local during festive seasons.Participation has now become ownership of transformation happening around the country, with the people becoming stakeholders in national development.

. SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey today said that the next wave in retail broking will not come from the big cities alone but will come from towns and villages.Addressing the 16th International Capital Market Convention of Association of NSE Members of India – ANMI, Mr. Pandey said, the best brokers do not just execute trades, they guide. Stating that KYC must be treated as “Know Your Client’s Needs”, SEBI Chairman said a client who understands risks invests wisely and stays invested longer.He further encouraged brokers to introduce investors to choices beyond equity like a bond, or a unit of a REIT or an InvIT.Raising serious concerns that about six in ten investors rely on unregistered  advisers  and  so-called  influencers, Mr. Pandey said SEBI’s campaign “Samajh Se Investing  Simple” has  drawn  over  15  crore views on social media and sent close to 110 crore WhatsApp messages since its launch on 5th October.Urging market participants to treat cyber security as a business priority, not an IT expense, the SEBI chief said a single breach can shake trust across the system.Stating that the International Monetary Fund – IMF  expects India to grow at about 7 percent  this year, which is more than twice the global pace, Mr. Pandey said, the prediction is largely due to the country’s young population, large domestic market and steady reforms.He informed that India’s equity market capitalization stands around 470 lakh crore rupees while Mutual Fund Assets Under Management – AUM stand around 83 lakh crore rupees.With over 15 crore unique investors and a foreign portfolio investor assets of about 74 lakh crore rupees, Mr. Pandey said the aim is to keep building a  market  that  is  simpler,  deeper  and  safer,  for investors and for market participants.In that direction, the SEBI Chief said, the regulator is reviewing  short  selling  and  securities  lending  and  borrowing  to improve liquidity and price discovery.He added that a framework is being developed to lift secondary trading in corporate bonds and another to put in place safeguards to prevent misuse of trading terminals. Mr. Pandey said SEBI is also exploring  an  AI  sandbox,  where  new  tools  can  be  tested  safely.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the Acting Head of State of the Principality of Liechtenstein, Hereditary Prince Alois, will hold a bilateral meeting in New Delhi today. They will discuss cooperation in various areas, including trade and investment, science, technology and innovation and people-to-people exchanges. Both will also exchange views on regional and global developments.Prince Alois was accorded a ceremonial reception at the forecourt of Rashtrapati Bhavan this morning. President Droupadi Murmu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcomed him. In a media statement, Prince Alois said that the visit bears testimony to the importance that Liechtenstein attaches to the relationship with India. He said that the conclusion of the trade and economic partnership agreement, TEPA, with India, which entered into force a year ago, marked a significant milestone in this regard. He further said that Liechtenstein is determined to build on this momentum and strengthen ties with India even further. Prince Alios also expressed gratitude to Prime Minister Narendra Modi for the invitation.He will also meet President Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan this evening, who will also host an official banquet in the honour of the visiting dignitary. External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar will also call on Prince Alois.The acting Head of State of the Principality of Liechtenstein arrived in New Delhi yesterday from Vadodara. Union Minister Jayant Singh received him at the airport. He is accompanied by his spouse, Princess Sophie and a high-level official, as well as a business delegation comprising top industry leaders.This is the second visit of Prince Alois to India in 2026. He earlier visited New Delhi in February this year to attend the AI Impact Summit. He had previously visited India in 2010 and 2018.The Ministry of External Affairs said the visit is expected to provide further impetus to the growing engagement between India and Liechtenstein, particularly since operationalization of the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement last year. The visit will provide an opportunity to further deepen the friendly ties between India and Liechtenstein and build partnerships in new areas of mutual interest.

. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh today saluted the courage, valour and sacrifice of the brave infantrymen of the Indian Army on the occasion of Shaurya Diwas. In a social media post, Mr Singh said that from the historic battlefields of 1947 to the most challenging frontiers of today, the infantrymen have held the line against overwhelming odds, stood firm whenever the nation needed them. He said they have made the supreme sacrifice to ensure that India stands tall. The Defence Minister further stated that their unwavering devotion to duty, exceptional courage and readiness to make the ultimate sacrifice embody the finest traditions of the Armed Forces. He added that the nation takes immense pride in its Infantry and will remain forever grateful for its service and sacrifice.

. External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar today called on the Acting Head of State of Liechtenstein, Hereditary Prince Alois. In a social media post, Dr Jaishankar said India and Liechtenstein’s bilateral partnership is witnessing strong momentum across a wide range of sectors, driven by opportunities arising from the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA). He also expressed anticipation for Hereditary Prince Alois’s meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi later today to advance cooperation between the two countries.

. India and Canada today held the inaugural meeting of the India-Canada Migration and Mobility Dialogue in New Delhi. The meeting was co-chaired by Secretary (Consular, Passport, Visa and Overseas Indian Affairs) in the External Affairs Ministry Sripriya Ranganathan and Deputy Minister of Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship of Canada, Ted Gallivan.During the meeting, the two sides signed the Terms of Reference for the Dialogue and reaffirmed their shared conviction that people are the strongest bridge between India and Canada. Discussions also focused on the mobility of students, skilled workers, professionals and business visitors as well as cooperation on migration management. The next meeting of the dialogue will be held in Canada.

. In Boxing, Aditya has become the first Indian male boxer to secure a medal at the ongoing World Boxing U-19 Championships in Budva, Montenegro.He defeated Italy’s Tommaso Orlando by a unanimous 5-nil decision to enter the men’s 55-kilogram semifinals today. Aditya will face Azerbaijan’s Nihat Gasimov in the semifinals.Meanwhile, Megha Sheokand in the women’s 80-kilogram category and Prachi Tokas in the women’s 57-kilogram category have also reached the semifinals, assuring India of medals in both events.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives aimed at removing the colonial mindset.The history of modern India is deeply entangled with two centuries of British colonialism, and decades after Independence. Over the past few years, the Government has slowly been steering India, away from these vestiges of British rule. Addressing the nation from the Red Fort on the 76th Independence Day in 2022, the Prime Minister outlined five resolutions, or Panch Pran for the next 25 years. Elaborating on the second Praan, he said, in no part of citizens’ existence, not even in the deepest corners of mind or habits should there be any ounce of slavery.In a concerted effort to free the country from its colonial legacy and promote a distinct Indian identity, the Government has undertaken a series of initiatives across various sectors. the historic Rajpath in New Delhi was renamed Kartavya Path and inaugurated by the Prime Minister in 2022.  Similarly, a grand statue of freedom fighter Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose was installed near India Gate, which has replaced the statue of King George the Fifth. The Indian Navy also adopted a new ensign in 2022, replacing the earlier design that featured the Saint George’s Cross. The Government has merged the Rail Budget with the Union Budget from budget year 2017-18, ending a practice dating back to 1924. BJP leader Ram Madhav has said that restoring India’s cultural and civilizational identity is a symbol of self-respect. He added that decolonisation is the real patriotism that is happening today.The Government has further sought to revive literature banned during British rule, with the National Archives of India compiling a catalogue of banned poems, writings and publications from the freedom struggle. In addition, more than 1,500 obsolete laws have been repealed in recent years as part of efforts to simplify governance and remove outdated legal provisions.These initiatives reflect the Government’s stated commitment to building a confident, self-reliant India rooted in its cultural heritage and national values.

. India is showcasing its growing capabilities in artificial intelligence, enterprise automation, AI computing infrastructure, cybersecurity, computer vision and intelligent digital solutions at the Dubai AI Festival 2026. The two-day festival, being held on 26-27 October at the Dubai World Trade Centre, focuses on the thematic idea of “Where Intelligence Meets Opportunity”. It brings together technology companies, investors, policymakers and industry leaders to discuss the development and adoption of artificial intelligence. The event is organised by Dubai AI Campus – a business and tech incubator initiative of the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), in partnership with the UAE Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence, Digital Economy and Remote Work Applications. This is the 3rd edition of the event, and the programme covers AI governance, enterprise transformation, computing infrastructure, investment, ethics and the application of AI across sectors.At the Bharat Pavilion, 23 Indian companies are presenting solutions spanning the entire gamut of the AI value chain, from cloud and GPU infrastructure required to train and deploy models to applications designed for specific industries. The pavilion was inaugurated by the Consul General of India in Dubai Dr. Dr. E. Vishnu Vardhan Reddy, on Monday.The showcase includes AI-ready computing infrastructure, GPU cloud services, data-centre capabilities and enterprise cloud management platforms. Indian exhibitors expressed confidence that the solutions they have developed in India have strong potential for deployment in other countries as well. They see the Dubai AI Festival as an important platform to connect with potential clients and partners, expand their global reach and take their technologies to newer markets.As Indian technology companies seek to expand their global footprint and explore new business partnerships, the festival offers Indian companies opportunities to project their capabilities for markets beyond India.

. Indian Olympic Association (IOA) president PT Usha today congratulated Indian para-athletes for their record-breaking performance at the Asian Para Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, where India finished fourth with 114 medals. India secured 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze medals, surpassing its previous best of 108 medals at the 2023 edition in Hangzhou, China.In a post on social media, Usha praised the athletes for their determination and hard work, while acknowledging the contribution of coaches and support staff to the team’s achievement. Para-athletics led India’s medal tally with 65 medals, followed by para-badminton with 16 and para-swimming with 11.Among the standout performers, Sumit Antil defended his gold in men’s javelin throw, while Simran Sharma won gold in both the women’s 100m and 200m T12 events, setting Games records in both races. Shooter Mona Agarwal also claimed gold in the women’s 50m rifle three positions SH1 event.

. Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister P K Mishra has emphasised the need for a holistic approach to disaster risk reduction, stronger institutional capacity and sustained investment in disaster preparedness and mitigation. Addressing a meeting on Disaster Preparedness in New Delhi today, Mr Mishra said disaster risks must be assessed holistically, moving beyond departmental silos and strengthening coordination among different institutions.Referring to India’s initiatives under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Mr Mishra said disaster risk reduction has become an important component of national development policy. He highlighted the Prime Minister’s 10-point agenda of 2016 and the amendments to the Disaster Management Act in 2025, which have further strengthened the institutional framework. Mr Mishra said that India has consistently supported stronger international cooperation on disaster risk reduction. During its G20 presidency in 2023, India initiated the G20 working group on disaster risk reduction. He said India is committed to supporting the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction, and it will contribute actively to shaping the framework that follows Sendai. The Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030 is a global agreement adopted by the UN to reduce disaster risk and losses.

. In Nigeria, at least 58 bodies have been recovered so far after unknown gunmen attacked the Binnari community in northeastern Taraba State on Friday. The police said the rescue operations are continuing, with several people still feared missing. The attack took place on the community’s weekly market day in Karim-Lamido Local Government Area. Police said 15 additional bodies were recovered from surrounding bushes and a river.The four-hour assault reportedly involved indiscriminate gunfire, the burning of houses and the displacement of families. A military spokesperson confirmed that four security personnel accompanying a convoy were killed. The Taraba State government has begun distributing relief materials to survivors and affected families. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack.

. Global crude oil prices fell today after surging last week, but remained near six-month highs. Brent crude was trading 1.4 per cent down at 115 US dollars and 11 cents per barrel. West Texas Intermediate crude was trading 1.9 per cent lower at 101 US dollars and 28 cents per barrel, at the time of writing this report.

. Cyclone Arnab has intensified into a severe cyclonic storm over the Bay of Bengal, and it is likely to further strengthen into a very severe cyclonic storm by this evening. The cyclonic storm over the Bay of Bengal is moving towards the Andhra Pradesh coast, with landfall expected tomorrow morning.Odisha is bracing for heavy to extremely heavy rainfall, particularly in its southern districts, as the storm approaches the eastern coastline. The State Government has intensified preparedness, while several train services have been cancelled or curtailed as a precaution. More from our Correspondent:

. The third season of the Nepal Premier League, Nepal’s premier franchise-based T20 cricket tournament, begins today at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur. The tournament will continue until November 21, with eight franchises competing for the title. The opening match will see defending champions Lumbini Lions take on last season’s runners-up, Sudurpaschim Royals. This season marks a major milestone, with International Cricket Council recognition and the introduction of the Decision Review System, allowing teams to challenge certain umpiring decisions. The tournament will feature international stars, including former Australian captain David Warner, West Indies all-rounder Andre Russell, South African batter David Miller and Bangladesh all-rounder Shakib Al Hasan.

. The India Meteorological Centre (IMD) has said that a well marked low pressure area over Eastcentral and adjoining Southeast Bay of Bengal persisted over the region today.It is most likely to persist over the region and intensify into a depression today. It is very likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify further into a deep depression tomorrow and into a cyclonic storm over the Westcentral Bay of Bengal by Monday morning.Under the influence of likely formation of cyclonic storm over the Westcentral Bay of Bengal by Monday and its further intensification, isolated extremely heavy rainfall is expected  over Coastal Andhra Pradesh on Tuesday and Wednesday and  further over Odisha and Telangana on Wednesday.IMD has issued red colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall with isolated extremely heavy rainfall over Kerala, Mahe, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal tomorrow.The Met Department has forecast Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep and South Interior Karnataka will experience heavy rainfall tomorrow. The weather agency has said that thunderstorms accompanied with lightning and gusty winds is likely over East Madhya Pradesh, and Andhra Pradesh tomorrow.

. Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal has said, India is negotiating free trade agreements with several countries and groups, with talks with Chile quite ripe for conclusion and negotiations with Canada making good progress. Mr. Goyal told reporters in Canada that negotiations with the South Africa-led Southern African Customs Union (SACU) group have started. The two have inked terms of reference to formally start negotiations towards a preferential trade agreement in August. The five members of SACU are Botswana, Eswatini (formerly Swaziland), Lesotho, Namibia and South Africa. In the trade pact with the US, he said India will have a comparative advantage over other countries and get preferential access. Talking about other pacts, he said Mexico is very keen to have an early harvest trade agreement. He expressed hope that the continuity of the government in Brazil following the election would help speed up negotiations to expand the Preferential Trade Agreement with the Mercosur bloc. Earlier, the minister met CEOs and business leaders of various sectors. Mr Goyal is on a two-day official visit to Canada.

. Global crude oil prices rose today. Brent crude was trading one per cent up at 114 US dollars and 31 cents per barrel. West Texas Intermediate crude was trading 1.2 per cent higher at 100 US dollars and 70 cents per barrel, at the time of writing this report.

. The State Bank of India (SBI) has individually notified customers whose personal data was identified in a recent suspected cyber incident, assuring them that their account balances and funds remain safe. In a statement issued yesterday, the country’s largest public sector lender said, the affected customers have been informed. The bank also advised customers to follow safe digital banking practices and remain alert to suspicious calls, messages and emails. SBI initiated a detailed investigation after receiving alerts on 16th of this month from its Threat Intelligence Service Provider, the Defence Cyber Agency and the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) about suspected customer data exposure on the dark web.A preliminary analysis of around three lakh 75 thousand records identified 3,897 customer records containing personally identifiable information. The information reportedly included names, mobile numbers, email addresses, dates of birth and residential addresses. The bank immediately activated its cyber incident response and containment measures. It also appointed an independent cybersecurity agency empanelled by CERT-In to assess the incident and establish the nature and extent of the suspected data exposure.SBI clarified that the incident had no material impact on its business operations, financial performance or continuity. It said its core banking services continue to function normally without disruption. The bank has urged customers never to share their one-time passwords, PINs or banking passwords with anyone and to exercise caution while responding to unsolicited communications.

. Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal has said India plans to increase its port capacity fourfold by 2047 to support economic growth andexpandinginternational trade. Speaking in Rotterdam during his visit to the Netherlands, Mr Goyal said, India had doubled its port capacity over the past decade and aims to quadruple it over the next two decades. He highlighted opportunities for cooperation with the Port of Rotterdam in the Netherlands in maritime infrastructure, green energy, carbon capture and sustainable trade.The Minister emphasised the importance of cooperation with the Port of Rotterdam in modernising existing ports, developing world-class infrastructure and improving operational efficiency. Highlighting the government’s Sagarmala initiative, the Minister said efforts were underway to expand port infrastructure and improve maritime connectivity.The Minister expressed confidence that stronger cooperation with major international maritime hubs such as Rotterdam would help India expand its maritime capabilities and strengthen its role in global trade.Describing India as the world’s fastest-growing major economy, Mr Goyal said the country had made significant progress in quality, efficiency and productivity, strengthening its position in global trade and logistics.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives like the PM Jan Dhan Yojana.Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana has emerged as a cornerstone of India’s financial inclusion journey since its launch in 2014 by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. With over 59 crore Jan Dhan accounts, the scheme has grown into the largest financial inclusion initiative in the world. The scheme has provided universal banking access for every household and has become the foundation for direct benefit transfers. It has helped save almost 3.5 lakh crore rupees by plugging leakages in welfare delivery.Addressing the centenary celebrations of Shri Ram College of Commerce in New Delhi last month, Prime Minister Narendra Modi had said that Jan Dhan Yojana has transformed India’s banking landscape and today almost every family in the country is connected to the banking system.As the world’s largest financial inclusion initiative, the scheme is redefining access to banking for millions of underprivileged citizens. The Jan Dhan account holder can avail overdraft facility of up to ten thousand rupees per household.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives like Give It Up Campaign.The Give It Up campaign, launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2015, has encouraged consumers to voluntarily give up their LPG subsidies. Under the campaign, more than one crore 13 lakh LPG consumers have voluntarily surrendered their LPG subsidy. The savings helped provide LPG connections to poor households under the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana, particularly benefiting rural women who relied on firewood and cow dung for cooking. The government has provided over ten crore 56 lakh free LPG connections under the scheme to adult women from poor households across the country. Addressing the Delhi Economics Conclave in 2015, Prime Minister Modi highlighted that the Give It Up movement inspired the citizens to come together to help underprivileged families acquire clean fuel.A resident of Uttar Pradesh, Sanju Devi said that the gas stove has made cooking much more convenient and freed her from exposure to smoke.The Give It Up campaign has promoted a sense of social responsibility among citizens and has supported the government’s efforts to ensure clean cooking fuel access for all.

. The two-day 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum will conclude in New Delhi today. Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, who is also the Chairperson of the Forum, will deliver the valedictory speech after the adoption of the joint statement. Thereafter, the presidency will be handed over to China. Vice President C P Radhakrishnan will host lunch in honour of the presiding officers and leaders of the delegation of Member and Partner Countries. The second and final day of the forum will begin with the fourth plenary on Sustainability: The role of parliaments in fostering a sustainable and inclusive future for our nations.The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum began yesterday with the theme “Fostering Parliaments for People-Centric Development.  Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with MPs from BRICS nations during the Forum. They exchanged perspectives on a wide range of issues. In his inaugural address, Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla called upon the Parliaments of BRICS member and partner countries to strengthen their collective resolve towards people-centric development, global peace, sustainability and international cooperation. Emphasizing the transformative potential of parliamentary engagement, he underscored the need to harness the collective wisdom of nations to address shared challenges, deepen mutual understanding and bring meaningful, positive change to the lives of citizens.Mr Birla also addressed the First Plenary Session of the Forum, which focused on the Critical Role of Parliaments in Strengthening Institutional Resilience for a Better Future.Addressing the Second Plenary Session focusing on Harnessing Parliaments for Promoting Human-centric Innovation in Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technologies, Mr Birla said, from Artificial Intelligence to Digital Transformation, the challenge is not merely to embrace emerging technologies but to ensure that they serve humanity, promote inclusive growth, expand equal opportunities and empower citizens.The third plenary was on Cooperation: Leveraging Parliamentary cooperation for a more representative global governance architecture.On the sidelines of the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum 2026, Mr Birla today held bilateral meetings with the Speaker of the Federal National Council of the UAE, Mr  Saqr Ghobash; Vice Chairman of the National People’s Congress of China, Mr Zheng Jianbang; and a member of the Praesidium of the Islamic Consultative Assembly of Iran, Mr Ahmed Naderi.During the meeting between  Om Birla and the Speaker of the Federal National Council of the UAE, Saqr Ghobash, both sides reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening the historic bonds of friendship between India and the UAE through enhanced parliamentary cooperation, regular dialogue and exchanges of parliamentary delegations. They also exchanged views on regional developments and underscored the importance of dialogue and diplomacy in promoting peace and stability.During the meeting between Om Birla and Vice Chairman of the National People’s Congress of China, Zheng Jianbang, the two leaders discussed strengthening India-China relations through parliamentary exchanges, regular dialogue and cooperation in areas such as education, healthcare and technology.  Mr Birla emphasised that, as neighbours, these two countries have a shared responsibility to maintain peace and tranquillity along the border and resolve differences amicably through dialogue and mutual respect.During his meeting with the Member of the Praesidium of the Islamic Consultative Assembly of  Iran, Ahmed Naderi, Mr Birla emphasised the importance of peace and stability in the region for the welfare of humanity and highlighted the role of parliamentary dialogue and bilateral engagements in advancing these shared objectives. The two sides also discussed taking forward Chabahar Port cooperation through joint efforts. Mr. Naderi expressed gratitude for the medicines, assistance and other support extended by India to Iran.

. India’s business sentiment improved in the July-September quarter of this fiscal year after declining for four consecutive quarters. The Business Confidence Index rose to 107.8 from 99.8 in the previous quarter, according to the latest survey by the National Council of Applied Economic Research (NCAER).The survey, conducted in September among 502 firms across six cities, found improvement in all four indicators of business confidence. The share of firms expecting overall economic conditions to improve over the next six months rose to 50 per cent from 43 per cent. Expectations of improved financial positions increased to 41 per cent from 37 per cent, while the share viewing the investment climate positively rose to 30 per cent from 26 per cent. Firms expecting capacity utilisation to remain near or above optimal levels increased to 94 per cent from 91 per cent.NCAER survey indicated a broad-based recovery in sentiment among both micro, small and medium enterprises and large firms. The Business Confidence Index for MSMEs rose from 93 to 100, while that for large firms increased from 111.6 to 120.3. She added that business prospects had improved in both domestic and external markets, while cost sentiments had moderated.

. Israelis are voting today in parliamentary elections, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu seeking to retain power amid public debate over the government’s handling of the October 7, 2023, Hamas attack, the subsequent wars and its domestic and foreign policies. The election is widely viewed as a test of Netanyahu’s leadership, with opposition figures, including former military chief Gadi Eisenkot and former prime minister Naftali Bennett, seeking to challenge his right-wing coalition.Israel follows a nationwide proportional representation system in which the entire country constitutes a single electoral constituency. Political parties must secure at least 3.25 per cent of the national vote to enter the Knesset. Netanyahu, leader of the right-wing Likud party, has served as prime minister for nearly 19 years across three separate periods since 1996. He is seeking to retain power following a turbulent period marked by the Hamas-led attack in October 2023 and the military campaigns that followed.The October 7 assault killed around 1,200 people in Israel and triggered the war in Gaza, which subsequently expanded into a wider regional conflict involving Israel, Iran and other armed groups.Security, accountability for the October 7 attack and the future of the war in Gaza are among the central issues in the election campaign.Former Israel Defence Forces chief of staff Gadi Eisenkot, who leads the centrist Yashar party, has emerged as one of Netanyahu’s principal challengers. Eisenkot previously served as an observer in Netanyahu’s war cabinet but resigned in June 2024, criticising the government for lacking a clear strategy for the war.Former prime minister Naftali Bennett is leading the B’Yachad electoral alliance, which includes former prime minister Yair Lapid’s Yesh Atid party. A right-wing politician who opposes Palestinian independence and supports Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, Bennett has also criticised Netanyahu’s handling of security and governance.Other significant political players include Yair Golan’s left-leaning Democrats, Avigdor Liberman’s Yisrael Beiteinu and Arab-led parties such as Ra’am and the Joint List.

. In Women’s Cricket, India defeated Zimbabwe by 121 runs in the second One Day International (ODI) in Vadodara tonight, taking an unassailable 2-nil lead in the three-match series. Chasing a target of 329 runs, Zimbabwe were bowled out for 207 in 48.5 overs. Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano top-scored with 46 runs off 57 balls. For India, Vaishnavi Sharma took four wickets, while Deepti Sharma claimed three. Earlier, opting to bat first, India posted 328 for six in their allotted 50 overs. Harmanpreet Kaur top-scored with 126 runs off 121 balls, while Deepti Sharma remained unbeaten on 106 off 87 deliveries. For Zimbabwe, Nomvelo Sibanda claimed two wickets. The third and final One Day International will be played at the same venue on Wednesday.

. India has reiterated its long-standing demand for comprehensive reforms in the United Nations Security Council, stressing that the veto power held by the five permanent members must not be used for narrow political interests.Delivering India’s statement at the United Nations, India’s Permanent Representative, Parvathaneni Harish, emphasised that the veto carries significant responsibility and must be exercised with restraint, particularly on matters concerning international peace and security.

. Major US stock indices ended lower yesterday as sell-off in tech stocks in the prior session shifted to other sectors of the market. Communication services, Consumer staples, Consumer discretionary, Financials and healthcare sectors were among the major laggards.The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell over 1.2 per cent, the S&P 500 dropped half a per cent and the Nasdaq Composite declined 0.2 per cent.The indices ended on a mixed note for the second consecutive week. During the week, the Nasdaq shed 0.7 per cent, and S&P 500 fell nearly half a per cent.Conversely, the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 0.4 per cent, marking its third straight weekly gain.

. In the French Open Badminton Championship, India’s two-time Olympic medallist PV Sindhu finished as the runner-up after a hard-fought three-game defeat to South Korea’s world No. 1, An Se-young, in Paris, France, today. In the women’s singles final, Sindhu won the opening game 21-16, but An Se Young bounced back strongly to claim the second game 21-11 and the deciding game 21-12, securing her third consecutive French Open title.

. The Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has intensified action against misleading advertisements and non-compliant sale of walkie-talkies. The CCPA has imposed a penalty of one lakh rupees on a private company for misleading advertisements and product listings of walkie-talkies that failed to disclose essential regulatory information, including operating frequencies and applicable licensing requirements. The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution said that the action forms part of the CCPA’s ongoing enforcement measures against misleading advertisements and unfair trade practices.It added that the CCPA had earlier taken suo motu cognisance of the large-scale listing and sale of walkie-talkies on e-commerce platforms without mandatory regulatory disclosures. During its examination, over sixteen thousand non-compliant listings were identified across platforms, and notices were issued to 13 e-commerce entities.The Ministry also informed that the Authority has so far passed final orders against 12 entities, imposing cumulative penalties of 58 lakh rupees for misleading advertisements and unfair trade practices relating to walkie-talkies.

. The Election Commission has defended its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls before the Supreme Court, maintaining that the exercise was authorised by law and the relevant orders were approved unanimously by all three members of the Commission.Rejecting the allegations that Form 6 had been amended, the poll panel, in its 248-page response to the petition against the chief election commissioner (CEC), said that no changes were made to the statutory Form 6 used for voter registration.A bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant is scheduled to hear on Tuesday petitions against CEC Gyanesh Kumar and the decisions taken by the poll panel during the SIR.In a counter-affidavit, the poll body sought summary dismissal of the petitions and called the allegations misconceived, which rested on a single newspaper report.The affidavit, filed by Deputy Election Commissioner Bhanu Prakash Yeturu on behalf of the Commission said attempt to make aspersions against the Election Commission is unfortunate.It said the affidavit itself had been approved for filing by a unanimous decision of all three members of the Commission.The Affidavit said the three SIR orders were issued in accordance with decisions of the EC arrived at unanimously and taken in due compliance with Article 324 of the Constitution of India.The poll body said any suggestion, observation or query raised by a commissioner while a file is being processed does not constitute a decision of the Commission.On the Form 6 row, the EC said it unequivocally rejects the misleading contention that the statutory form had been changed.It added that Form 6 is an application through which an eligible person seeks inclusion in the electoral rollsAccording to the affidavit, the declaration attached during the SIR is a separate document provided by the SIR orders and “is not a part of Form 6.It said the declaration used in the Bihar SIR was later replaced in the subsequent orders so that applicants could give details of themselves and their parents or grandparents from the 2002-03 rolls and avoid submitting further documents once successfully mapped.The poll body also said that appeals filed in West Bengal against orders including electors in the rolls were filed by officers of the state chief electoral officer’s office acting as statutory authorities in line with the apex court’s orders, and that ” matters were not brought to the Commission.Questioning the maintainability of the pleas, the Commission said, in the eyes of law, a newspaper report is not treated as evidence of the facts it narrates.The Commission added that it has “neither released nor authorised the release of any internal note/ file to any news agency.Citing Article 324(5) of the Constitution, which protects the CEC from removal except in the manner of a Supreme Court judge, the EC said any prayer to restrain the CEC from functioning was not maintainable.It also rejected the petitioner’s contentions on electronic voting machines (EVMs). The EC said similar challenges had been rejected by the top court several times.

. The International Weightlifting Federation (IWF) today announced that Ahmedabad will host the Senior World Weightlifting Championships in 2029. This will be the first time that India hosts the senior edition of the prestigious global event. The decision was taken at the IWF Executive Board meeting held in Ningbo, China. The IWF also awarded the hosting rights for the 2030 Senior World Weightlifting Championships to Moscow, the capital of Russia. Additionally, the IWF Executive Board decided to award the hosting rights for the 2028 World Youth Championships to Prishtina, Kosovo, and the World Junior Championships to Caracas, Venezuela.

. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh has departed for Cebu, Philippines, to attend the 13th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM)-Plus. In a social media post, Mr Singh said that he looks forward to addressing the forum on shared regional and international security issues. The Minister also reiterated India’s commitment to ASEAN centrality and the peace, stability, and collective growth of the Indo-Pacific region under the Act East Policy. He said that the ADMM-Plus remains the premier platform for defence and strategic consultations in the region.During the visit, he will hold several bilateral meetings with his counterparts from participating nations. The Defence Minister said that these interactions will be a great opportunity to review ongoing defence ties and explore new avenues to strengthen the strategic partnerships.

Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) have remained net sellers of Indian equities, withdrawing 48,056 crore rupees in October so far amid elevated crude oil prices and escalating geopolitical tensions. However, last week they moderated their selling and turned net buyers on two trading days, signalling some easing in selling pressure.According to the latest depository data, of the total net outflows, 53,337 crore rupees were withdrawn through sales on stock exchanges. However, FPI investments through the primary market continued to witness inflows, amounting to 5,281 crore rupees so far this month.Meanwhile, the debt market has seen a mixed trend in Foreign Portfolio Investors’ flows during the period under review. FPIs have infused 3,737 crore rupees into debt securities through the General Limit route in October so far. In contrast, withdrawals from the Fully Accessible Route (FAR) stood at 3,858 crore rupees, while the Voluntary Retention Route (VRR) recorded outflows of 1,332 crore rupees.

. In Czech Republic, thousands of people held a massive protest yesterday in the capital Prague, against a new plan by the government, led by the country’s Prime Minister Andrej Babiš. This plan changes how public broadcasters – including radio and television, receive their funding. Many people believe, this change will dangerously hurt the independence of the media.Protesters are angry because the ruling government coalition suddenly moved forward with the plan in the lower house of Parliament two days ago. To pass the plan, coalition lawmakers quickly opened the debate and strictly limited the time opposition lawmakers had to speak. Parliament then voted to approve the first of three required readings in the morning at 4:36 AM. The protesters demanded a withdrawal of the draft and called on Babiš to enable a thorough public debate on the issue first.Under the new government plan, public radio and television will be funded directly from the state budget. Right now, they are funded by regular fees paid by individuals, households, and businesses. This new budget plan would also cut the media’s funding by about 15 percent.Public media workers announced they will go on strike on the 3rd of next month over the issue. They have strong support from labor unions, university rectors, churches, international media groups, and many others. The protesters also vowed to organize a rally at Prague’s Letná park on 15th of next month. Prime Minister Babiš formed a governing coalition last year with two small political groups whose agenda includes reducing support for Ukraine and rejecting some key European Union policies.

IMD added that the deep depression is very likely to move nearly southwestwards, and intensify further into a cyclonic storm over east central adjoining Southeast Bay of Bengal by early morning tomorrow. It has advised fishermen not to venture into West Central and adjoining Northwest and Southwest Bay of Bengal during the next two days.The Weather Agency has issued an orange colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall over Kerala, Mahe, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal tomorrow. The maximum temperature in the National Capital will be around 31 to 33 degrees Celsius, while the minimum temperature will hover around 15 to 17 degrees Celsius tomorrow.

. In the French Open Badminton Championship, two-time Olympic medallist PV Sindhu will take on South Korea’s world No. 1 An Se Young in the women’s singles final this afternoon. The match will be held at the Stade Roland Garros complex in Paris, France, with the winner crowned the French Open 2026 women’s singles champion. Sindhu booked her place in the final for the first time in her career after defeating Japan’s Hina Akechi in a thrilling three-game semifinal in Paris yesterday.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives like GST Council.Introduced on 1STJuly, 2017, the Goods and Services Tax (GST) marked a significant milestone in India’s tax reform journey. By bringing multiple Central and State taxes under a unified framework, GST gave effect to the principle of One Nation, One Tax and paved the way for a more integrated and streamlined taxation system across the country. The proposals of the GST Council seek to create a more predictable and taxpayer-friendly GST registration framework. Under the next-generation GST reforms last year, the GST council had simplified the earlier four-tier structure of 5 per cent, 12 percent, 18 percent, 28 percent into a two tier structure of 5 percent and 18 percent. Addressing the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi today, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said that through GST, the government has transformed a complex web of taxes into a national market.Addressing media after the 58thGST Council meeting in New Delhi, Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said that the Council   recommended removing arrest powers under GST, raising the prosecution threshold from one crore to five crore rupees.Over the past nine years, standardised procedures and rationalised rates have supported greater transparency, accountability and economic growth and strengthened the vision of ‘Ek Bharat – Shreshtha Bharat’.

. A school teacher was allegedly beaten to death while attempting to mediate a land and road dispute in Dinajpur district of Bangladesh on Sunday. Police have arrested one person in connection with the incident. The deceased was identified as Manoranjan Roy, 55, an assistant headteacher at a government primary school.According to Media reports, the incident occurred in Naya Mollapara village under Parbatipur upazila, where a dispute between neighbours escalated into violence. Manoranjan Roy reportedly intervened to calm the two sides but was allegedly attacked. He died at the scene. Police said further investigation is underway to establish the circumstances of the death and identify others involved.

Brent crude was trading 1.1 per cent down at 115 US dollars and 41 cents per barrel. West Texas Intermediate crude was trading 1.6 per cent lower at 101 US dollars and 62 cents per barrel, at the time of writing this report.

. In Tennis, India’s top-ranked doubles player, Yuki Bhambri, with his American partner Ryan Seggerman, clinched the Almaty Open title in Kazakhstan today. The fourth-seeded Indo-American pair defeated top seeds Lucas Miedler and Neil Oberleitner of Austria 7-6, 6-7, 10-2 in the final of ATP 250 tournament. The victory marks Bhambri’s first ATP Tour title of the 2026 season and the fifth doubles title of his career on the ATP Tour. The 34-year-old had previously won ATP 250 titles in Mallorca in 2023, Gstaad and Munich in 2024, and the ATP 500 Dubai tournament in 2025.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues.Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives.Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through the FDI Policy.India’s foreign direct investment policy has undergone major reforms over the past decade, with the government liberalising sectoral rules to attract greater foreign investment into the country. The government has progressively liberalised FDI norms in key sectors, including defence, telecommunications, insurance and space. Foreign investment of up to 74 per cent is permitted in defence, 100 per cent in telecom, insurance and Space sector. The country has received a record over 748 billion US dollars in FDI between 2014 and 2025. The number of source countries investing in India also rose from 89 to 112. Addressing the Rozgar Mela in New Delhi, Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted that today more than one hundred countries are investing in India through FDI.Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran said that India has opened up several sectors, including space, drones, defence and insurance, to foreign investment.The FDI policy reforms reflect India’s efforts to create a more investor-friendly environment, simplified investment procedures and to strengthen its position as a preferred global investment destination.

. The 61st Meeting of the International Committee of Legal Metrology commenced in New Delhi today. For the first time, India is hosting this international meeting, bringing together delegates, senior officials and technical experts from across the world to advance cooperation in measurement standards, consumer protection and fair trade.Addressing the gathering, Consumer Affairs Secretary Nidhi Khare emphasised that accurate and internationally harmonised measurements are fundamental to fair trade, consumer confidence, industrial innovation and economic growth. Highlighting India’s commitment to consumer protection alongside ease of doing business, the Secretary referred to the Jan Vishwas reforms of 2023 and 2026.She said that these reforms have introduced measures such as decriminalisation of specified offences, improvement notices and graded penalties, promoting a more proportionate and business-friendly regulatory framework while retaining essential consumer safeguards. She highlighted the expansion of Government Approved Test Centres to augment verification capacity and the development of the e-Maap National Portal to provide integrated digital services in legal metrology.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi today congratulated Brazilian President Lula da Silva, on his re-election victory. In a social media post, Prime Minister Modi said that he looks forward to working closely with the Brazilian President to further deepen and expand the multifaceted India-Brazil Strategic Partnership. Mr Modi added that together, India and Brazil will continue to strengthen cooperation across diverse sectors, advance the shared priorities of the Global South and work towards a more inclusive, equitable and sustainable world.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave ESTIC 2026 today at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. He will also address the gathering on the occasion. The three-day Conclave will bring together leading scientists, researchers, academicians, policymakers, industry leaders, startups and international experts to deliberate on emerging technologies and India’s science, technology and innovation priorities.The deliberations will span 12 thematic areas, including artificial intelligence, biotechnology, advanced materials, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, climate and ocean sciences. Discussions will focus on research priorities, national capabilities and translating scientific advances into practical applications. The Conclave will also feature an extensive technology and innovation exhibition showcasing indigenous scientific achievements and emerging technologies. It will include around 150 deep-tech startup stalls, which will highlight technological developments and their potential applications across sectors. The Conclave will also use thematic videos, technology demonstrations, documentaries, informational kiosks and augmented and virtual reality experiences to enhance engagement with scientific developments and their real-world applications. A new initiative, the Global Connect Networking Event, will bring together more than 300 invited participants from academia, research institutions and industry in India and abroad. It will provide a platform to explore international research partnerships, industry-academia collaboration and pathways for translating innovations from laboratories to markets.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has congratulated Indian para-athletes for their record 114-medal haul at the Asian Para Games 2026 in Japan, calling the country’s best-ever performance at the Games an occasion of immense pride and joy for the entire nation. . Akashvani will organise the 67th edition of the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Lecture series today. Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Shivraj Singh Chouhan, will deliver the lecture. The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting informed that the recording of the Lecture will be broadcast on Sardar Patel Jayanti on the 31st of October on the entire Akashvani Network at 9.30 P.M. Akashvani has been organizing the Annual Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Lecture series since 1955 in memory of India’s first Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Information and Broadcasting, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. The Ministry said that this annual event has served as a repository of thoughts, ideas and views on a variety of subjects and as a tool to understand the unfathomable expanse and depth of many aspects of our diverse culture and developmental issues in a better way.

Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal has said, India and the US have concluded most of the discussions for a proposed bilateral trade pact, and they are now fine-tuning the agreement.Addressing the India-Netherlands Business Forum in The Hague today, he said India has concluded nine free trade agreements in the last four and a half years. The minister is in The Hague on a two-day official visit to the Netherlands. He is accompanying a business delegation.

. The Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games concluded today with a closing ceremony at the Mizuho Park Athletics Stadium in Nagoya, Japan.Around 4,000 athletes and staff from 45 countries and regions participated in the week-long Games, held in Japan for the first time.Double gold medallists Nishad Kumar and Mona Agarwal led the Indian contingent as flag-bearers at the closing ceremony.India finished the Games with a record 114 medals including 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze medals, surpassing its previous tally of 108 medals at the 2023 Asian Para Games in Hangzhou, China.Para athletics was India’s biggest medal contributor, with 65 medals, including 22 gold, 19 silver and 24 bronze. Para badminton followed with 16 medals, including three gold, five silver and eight bronze. India also secured 11 medals in para swimming, seven in para table tennis, six in para archery, five in para shooting, and two each in para judo and para powerlifting.The sixth edition of the Asian Para Games will be held in Doha in 2030.
